trigger.history: v5, v7 and v9 source reviews all HOLD; v8 parent-rejected for human-readable Python timestamps.

contract.children: Only separately reviewed children whose source contract is single-process: no fork/exec/subprocess/multiprocessing; native threads allowed. Current targets: fixedB NumPy assay, Lemma U certificate producer/checker/expectation programs.
contract.ownership: Owned set = child plus every process ever observed in the child process group or with an owned current parent at any sample. ANY observed owned process other than the child is a latched failure (contract violation) and blocks parent release until all such identities are verified ended.
contract.unrelated_processes: New same-uid processes not linked by an observed current-parent edge or child process group are NOT blocking. This avoids treating ordinary launchd/user-agent activity as owned. Residual documented limitation: an intentionally fast fork+setsid+intermediate-exit by a contract-violating child can evade sampling. Mitigation is source review of the child contract; the supervisor is not an OS sandbox.
contract.timestamps: Supervisor writes NO human-readable timestamps and spawns no /bin/date helper. It records only raw monotonic and raw epoch telemetry fields explicitly labelled as such. Human-readable timestamps are written only by the parent after reading /bin/date (GO, audits, releases). This is not a Python-rendered timestamp substitute; v8 remains rejected.
contract.freshness: GO carries parent-computed raw not_after_epoch and stability receipt digest; supervisor compares raw clocks at each commit boundary after I/O.
contract.unchanged: One identity-checked owned-group SIGTERM, bounded grace, no SIGKILL/timeouts/ulimit/deletion; exclusive outputs; 10GiB lane ceiling; free floor; <=2 busy; parent exact GO and independent post-exit commit; uncertain settlement/evidence/publication blocks release.

required_v10_repairs: clearance accepted only at a monotonic time when ALL predicates are verified, checked against all cutoffs
fresh expiry/fit/resource checks after I/O at protected launch/GO/acknowledgment commit points; cancellation serialized there
exact final payload bytes budgeted and written; reservation charges all launch/tmp/evidence bytes; refuse publication when unbudgeted
retained anchored lane-disk root identity for accounting walks
shared deadline checks after every completion path, fail closed on overrun
identity bracketing with uniqueid+idversion+ruid/euid for any measurement used for ownership/accounting
scope_limit: This decision governs source design only. No source acceptance, qualification or science GO follows.
